threads.body: In this metric point assertion, `hasAttributesSatisfying(...)` is weaker than the other `messaging.receive.messages` assertions in this test suite (which use `hasAttributesSatisfyingExactly(...)`) and it also no longer asserts the `messaging.operation=receive` attribute. This can allow the test to pass even if the instrumentation sets unexpected/wrong attributes for the point. Consider switching to the exact attribute assertion and include `MESSAGING_OPERATION` alongside destination/system/server attributes (consistent with the other tests in this module).
